name: Park
summary: Night elf visitors find a quiet haven in Stormwind's Park, on the city's western edge. Between Cathedral Square and the Mage Quarter, its greenery offers rest, and its druid trainers are the only ones in the Eastern Kingdoms.

sections.title: A Grove in the Stone Capital
sections.body: Stormwind's Park brings a quiet stretch of wilderness into the stone capital. Once a place where the city's people sought recreation, it became an enclave for night elf emissaries and travelers from across the Great Sea. Shaded canopies shelter the district, and a Moonwell stands at its heart. Here, the sacred glades of Kalimdor find an echo in the human kingdom.

sections.title: Sanctuary and Fellowship
sections.body: Night elves have a foothold in foreign lands within Park. Kaldorei priests such as Nara Meideros tend visiting pilgrims, while druidic mentors guide those devoted to the wild. Weary travelers can rest here, away from the clatter of the Trade District and the solemn duties of the Cathedral.

faq.q: Where is the Park located in Stormwind?
aliases: how to get to the park
faq.answer: Park lies along Stormwind City's far western edge. From Cathedral Square, head southwest; from the Mage Quarter, head northwest.

faq.q: Why are there so many night elves in the Park?
faq.answer: Visiting night elves found refuge in Park from Stormwind's towering stone streets. Its groves and quiet air reminded them of home, and they established a Moonwell in the square.

faq.q: Can I train druid abilities here?
aliases: where to train druid eastern kingdoms
faq.answer: Yes. Park is the only place in the Eastern Kingdoms with Alliance druid trainers. They guide and train Kaldorei practitioners far from Kalimdor.

faq.q: What is the glowing pool in the center of the Park?
faq.answer: The pool at the center of Park is a consecrated night elven Moonwell. Kaldorei visitors created it as a sacred font of spiritual peace and lunar power within the human city.

angles.text: As a night elf, you find a taste of home in Park, with a glowing Moonwell and familiar teachers of Elune and the wild.
As a druid, you find the Eastern Kingdoms' sole sanctuary for training and counsel in Park.
